items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler' by Sansec, allows unauthenticated remote code execution on vulnerable Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. It was actively exploited in the wild before a patch was released, enabling attackers to inject and execute malicious PHP code via Magento's template-processing functionality.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This emergency security update addresses CVE-2026-75650, a critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this vulnerability being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addressing critical and important vulnerabilities. These issues could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.
